title: Speech synthesis fails mid-utterance
description: The TTS sidecar or managed TTS fails during an utterance; the fallback audio path must keep safety and error prompts usable.
callerVisible: The caller hears a pre-recorded approved prompt and is connected to a person if needed.
backendEvidence: TTS failure recorded on the release receipt
notes: Added to the fixed fault registry for the follow-on prompt section 17 fault matrix. The LOCAL FIXTURE driver does not inject it (NOT_SUPPORTED); only the Layer-2 run tagged [FAULT:TTS_FAILURE] owned by WP-15 proves it.

registry.injectionPoint: the TTS sidecar or managed TTS fails mid-utterance

postconditions: Fallback audio is pre-approved and released through the same guard
Safety prompts stay usable without TTS
The partial utterance is recorded as not completed
